text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl's main goal is to challenge the impossible. In other words, she wants to give courage to the world by becoming the first Tracen racer to win a European G1.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now that she's decided to forego the Prix Maurice de Gheest, the only way for her to achieve her goal is to beat Taiki Shuttle at the Prix Jacques Le Marois.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But… is that even possible?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I want to hear your opinion first, Trainer. I'm sure you've already gone over it from every possible angle.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: If I run in the Prix Jacques Le Marois, is there a strategy I can use that will actually help me beat Taiki?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've run the simulations time and time again in my head, and my final conclusion is…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Impossible? Could you explain why you think so?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: First, there's the difference in your abilities.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just as Seeking the Pearl previously acknowledged, Taiki Shuttle's proficiency in mile races is astounding.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We have to admit she's a cut above us in that regard. In addition to that, there are the track conditions to consider.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The deep turf and soft ground of European tracks both work to Taiki Shuttle's advantage. On top of that…
choice_data_list: There's also the difference in training environment.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Training environment? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: According to Sirius Symboli's notes, there are significant differences between the training facilities in France and at Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In order to beat Taiki Shuttle, who is significantly stronger than her, she would need a very detailed training routine, but it would be impossible to carry that out perfectly in an unfamiliar environment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Considering all of those things…
choice_data_list: I think it's impossible for you to win, no matter how I look at it.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: So it's impossible… I see… If you say so, then it must be true.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: To be honest, I feel the same way, but for a completely different reason to yours.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The reason I don't think I can beat Taiki in the Prix Jacques Le Marois…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Is because of destiny.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Just as I have my destiny, Taiki has her own…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I feel a strong connection between Taiki and the Prix Jacques Le Marois.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I think it's her destined race. And…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Even if I think I can surpass my own destiny, I don't think I can go as far as to change hers.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That's just my opinion, but it seems whatever way we look at it, I won't be able to beat Taiki in that race.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: If I'm going to run it anyway, then I'm going to go into it fully prepared to lose.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Running a race you know you're going to lose might sound romantic to some people…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But Seeking the Pearl isn't running to spread grief around the world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Isn't there another way? A way she can give hope to the world without running away from Taiki Shuttle? There must be.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I can't beat Taiki as I am now. I have no choice but to give up on becoming the first Tracen racer to win a European G1.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: But what can I do? If I forfeit that achievement, then what greater feat must I accomplish to make up for it and prove my potential?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Taiki's going to become a world champion. Am I supposed to continue praising and fawning over her forever? Or…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I listen to Seeking the Pearl talk, an idea forms in my head…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even if she gives up being the first winner of a European G1, all she needs to do is claim a bigger victory somewhere down the line. That's the only way she can inspire hope in people.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She may not be able to defeat her greatest rival now, but that all changes if she can prove herself stronger than said rival at a later date!
choice_data_list: I know what path we should take, Pearl.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Are you saying there's another way forward?
choice_data_list: Let's wait until Taiki Shuttle returns and challenge her in Japan!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: What? You mean like right after she makes her triumphant return?
choice_data_list: Exactly. We'll have you beat her in a sprint after you've gotten stronger.
Exactly. We'll have you beat her in a sprint after you've gotten stronger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Someone as tough as Taiki Shuttle may very well run in some domestic races before the end of the year, even after returning from abroad.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell her it's likely we'll see her in the Sprinters Stakes in the fall. Since it's a domestic 1,200-meter race, we have a real fighting chance!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The Sprinters Stakes! I see… If she's going to run in that…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Then I need to be sure I'm ready to face her when the time comes. And if I beat Taiki after she wins abroad…
choice_data_list: You'll be able to show off the possibilities you possess!
You'll be able to show off the possibilities you possess!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle may be stronger than Seeking the Pearl right now, but that doesn't mean the status quo will stay the same forever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even if she has to give up on being the first European G1 winner from Tracen, all she has to do is defeat the champion who does manage to claim that honor, then make it to the international stage and do well!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That's not an easy path, though. It may even be more difficult than coming up with some clever way to be the first to win a European G1…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: But I have to do this! I want to show the world my potential without running away from anything!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: …Okay. It's time to part ways with my destiny of becoming the first to win a G1 abroad.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Fare thee well, my glory… I hope we will meet again one day…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I may have released the dream I've been holding on to for so long, but now, I shall reach for an even greater glory!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That's right… I'm only trading one destiny for another.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: By starting anew, I will be able to aim ever higher! And the first thing I need to do to accomplish that…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Is to win against Taiki Shuttle in the Sprinters Stakes after she returns victorious from abroad! This is the only path left for me!
